Snakes and Ladders Rules

A dice game of pure luck: climb the ladders, avoid the snakes, and be first at the top.

The rules

The board
The fields are numbered in a snake line from the bottom left: along the bottom row, up, back along the next row, and so on. The big board has 100 fields, the small one for little children 50. Ladders lead up, snakes lead down.
A turn
Roll the die and move your token that many fields on. Tokens start off the board and come onto field 1 to 6 with the first roll. Any number of tokens may share a field.
Ladders and snakes
If your token stops at the foot of a ladder, it climbs straight up to the top. If it stops on a snake's head, it slides down to the tail. Passing over them does nothing.
The finish
The first to reach the last field wins. Two ways to finish: "Spare pips are lost" (the default) - a roll that would go past the end still reaches it; "Exactly onto the last field" - the roll must fit exactly, otherwise the token stays where it is.
Players
2 to 4 players on one device, and as many of them as you like played by the computer. Tokens are told apart by their shape: circle, square, triangle and star.
